name: @crsiebler/mcp-salesforce-server
description: Salesforce MCP server for CRUD operations using REST APIs
author: Cory Siebler <cory.siebler@phitechsolutions.com>

environment.notes: Startup needs no credentials. Provider calls need an instance URL plus access token, or all four client ID/client secret/username/password variables for existing automatic authentication. Append a security token to password when required; there is no SALESFORCE_SECURITY_TOKEN environment reader. Authentication behavior is unchanged.
